## Purpose

Summarize the synthetic clause governing recurring business-system reviews.

## The rule

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Instrument | FAR codified synthetic rule [@CL-CMP-0001] |
| Codified citation | 48 CFR 9900.101 [@CL-CMP-0001] |
| RFO citation | Not established. |
| Edition date | 2026-01 [@CL-CMP-0001] |
| Text status | Final synthetic rule [@CL-CMP-0001] |
| Applies to | Fixed-price synthetic awards [@CL-CMP-0001] |

The synthetic clause requires a system review every 30 days [@CL-CMP-0001] and sets a 5 percent billing withhold [@CL-CMP-0002].

## How it works

Contracting officers apply the synthetic clause to covered awards and monitor the review schedule.

## Worked example

Synthetic example. The numbers are made up.

A covered contract with 200,000 USD in monthly billings faces a 10,000 USD hold when a deficiency remains open.

## Never confuse

Do not confuse this synthetic clause card with an uncodified agency class deviation.
